title.value: 2027 Admissions to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
title.evidence_quote: 2027 Admissions to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School are Now Open!

institution.name: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS), Tsinghua University

qualifications: Bachelor's or master's degree obtained before the 2027 registration date
English proficiency for non-native speakers (e.g. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 85, per the admissions page)
description_short: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School is accepting international applications for 2027 entry to its master's and doctoral programmes (40 master's, 22 doctoral). Applications go through Tsinghua's international portal; the general deadline is 15 May 2027, 17:00 Beijing time. Some programmes close earlier.
status_evidence: Official SIGS announcement (seen in search results): "2027 Admissions to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School are Now Open!", closing 17:00 Beijing Time on May 15, 2027
Programme pages (e.g. Synthetic Biology and Biomanufacturing) list "Application Deadline May 15, 2027"
Capped at OPEN_LIKELY: the page could not be fetched and the portal was not independently confirmed
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment
Some programmes have earlier rounds (e.g. Tsinghua SEM Master of Finance rounds closing December 2026 and February 2027; Tsinghua-Columbia Business Analytics closing 26 February 2027)
Fellowships Guide post ("Tsinghua University SIGS Scholarship 2027 for MS & PhD", 3 November 2026) not located; source_url is its scholarships category page
Scholarship terms not verified; the admissions page only says scholarships are available
Tuition varies by programme (RMB 30,000-75,000 per year, per the search summary)
